    EgradxLogShippingAutoConfiguration
    Log shipping, when egradx.observability.logging.shipping.enabled is true and there is an EgradxLogSink (egradx-platform-events provides one): an EgradxLogShippingAppender on Logback's root logger, attached once the application has started and detached, after a last flush, when it stops.
